an10.86:8.3: And they declare enlightenment out of overestimation:
an10.86:8.4: “I understand: ‘Rebirth is ended, the spiritual journey has been completed, what had to be done has been done, there is nothing further for this place.’”’
an10.86:11.2: and often lives with a heart full of ill will.
an10.86:11.3: But being full of ill will means decline in the teaching and training proclaimed by the Realized One.
an10.86:12.2: and often lives with a heart full of dullness and drowsiness.
an10.86:12.3: But being full of dullness and drowsiness means decline in the teaching and training proclaimed by the Realized One.
an10.86:13.2: and often lives with a heart full of restlessness.
an10.86:13.3: But being full of restlessness means decline in the teaching and training proclaimed by the Realized One.
an10.86:14.2: and often lives with a heart full of doubt.
an10.86:14.3: But being full of doubt means decline in the teaching and training proclaimed by the Realized One.
an10.86:15.2: But relishing work means decline in the teaching and training proclaimed by the Realized One.
an10.86:16.2: But relishing talk means decline in the teaching and training proclaimed by the Realized One.
an10.86:17.2: But relishing sleep means decline in the teaching and training proclaimed by the Realized One.
an10.86:18.2: But relishing company means decline in the teaching and training proclaimed by the Realized One.
